# Projector Lamp Swap

Replace the sanctuary projector lamp safely.

Warning: The lamp is hot for 15 minutes after power-off.

## Before you start

- [ ] Spare lamp from the cabinet
- [x] Ladder

## Procedure

1. Power down the projector
2. Wait for the lamp to cool
    1. Check the housing is cool to touch
    2. Remove the lamp door screws
3. Install the new lamp

| Model | Lamp part |
|-------|-----------|
| PT-RZ | ET-LAD |

```bash
reset-lamp-hours --confirm
```

Note: Log the swap in the gear record.
